title: SongUploaded
description: PROPOSAL, pending approval by the Upload Service owner (plan.md §10). Published by Upload on routing key song.uploaded after the audio (and lyrics, if any) are stored in S3 and the upload is committed. Consumed by Lyrics and Waveform. Upload may add further payload fields; consumers ignore fields they do not use.

audio_reference.description: S3 object key of the uploaded audio in the audio bucket, e.g. "audio/<song_id>.mp3".

lyrics_reference.description: S3 object key of the uploaded timestamped lyrics (LRC format) in the same bucket, e.g. "lyrics/<song_id>.lrc". Absent or null when the song has no lyrics (instrumental).
